description: Main front-end source file for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game, including theme setup, main widget, game logic, UI components, and rendering of the game board.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget setting the theme and home screen for the Tic Tac Toe app.

classes.name: TicTacToeScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget managing game state, UI layout, and game logic.

classes.name: _CounterChip
classes.description: Widget for displaying a counters for wins with label and icon.

classes.name: _TurnPill
classes.description: Widget indicating the current player's turn.

classes.name: _Board
classes.description: Widget representing the 3x3 game grid, with tap handling.

classes.name: _BoardTile
classes.description: Widget representing individual game cell with visual state.

classes.name: _BoardGridPainter
classes.description: Custom painter to draw grid lines overlay on the game board.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, runs the MyApp widget.

methods.name: _oceanColorScheme
methods.description: Defines the color scheme for the app theme.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Constructs and returns the ThemeData using the color scheme.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for MyApp returning MaterialApp.

methods.name: _TicTacToeScreenState.build
methods.description: Builds the game screen layout with counters, game board, and controls.

methods.name: _onCellTap
methods.description: Handles player move on clicking a cell, updates game state.

methods.name: _checkGameEnd
methods.description: Checks for win or draw conditions after each move.

methods.name: _showGameEndMessage
methods.description: Displays a brief message when game ends.

methods.name: _restartRound
methods.description: Resets the game board for a new round, counters persist.
